output.summary: Turnover rose far more than the in-state peer median (+19 vs +5 points), and payroll reconciliation rules out a migration artifact. The monthly step up occurred in March 2026, coinciding with the all-branch two-Saturday policy and before ShiftWise went live in April. That points to the Saturday change more than ShiftWise, but there is no branch-level data to test ShiftWise. Pay is cited by about 60% of leavers in both years and the market position is unknown, so a 15% irreversible raise is premature. Manager-based accountability uses a stale manager field and would punish the wrong people. Next steps: branch-level separations with corrected manager dates, a ShiftWise versus non-ShiftWise comparison, and a current pay benchmark.
